Ongoing — weeks or months (repeatable tasks at every level)

The dangerous creatures that infest the world are growing more and more threatening, and several NPCs ask for help in thinning them out. The centre of this system is the Paw and Fur Society run by {npc:Grizzly Adams} in Port Hope: you do hunting tasks according to your level, earn points, climb ranks and unlock bosses. On top of that, there are rankless tasks given by other NPCs. You receive experience, money, access to bosses, the {item:Demon Backpack}, the {item:Holy Icon}, trips with {npc:Lorek}, the right to sell trophies and many achievements.
The dangerous creatures plaguing these lands are becoming more and more threatening. The inhabitants may need some help dealing with them...

1. Start at the Paw and Fur Society (Grizzly Adams)
The Paw and Fur Society is the heart of this quest. {npc:Grizzly Adams} gives you tasks according to your level; each finished task gives points and, with enough points, you rank up.
Go to **Port Hope** and climb to the Paw and Fur Society building, where {npc:Grizzly Adams} is (1 floor above ground).

Say {key:hi} and then {key:task} (or {key:tasks}). He lists the available creatures **for your level range**. Say the name of the creature you want to hunt (e.g. {key:crocodiles}) and confirm with {key:yes}. The exact words for each task are in the tables of sections 2 to 5.
You can repeat this step to have up to 3 active tasks at the same time.
Kill the requested number of creatures. A creature only counts if you deal most of the damage (or if you are in a party with shared experience and hit it). Dead summons do not count.
If you repeat a task, the counter goes back to 0: creatures you killed beyond the previous task do not carry over to the next.

Go back to {npc:Grizzly Adams} and say {key:hi} and {key:task}. You receive the task's experience and points. If the task has a boss, he tells you about the boss right away and you now have an active boss task (you can only have **one** task for each boss active at a time).

Go to the boss teleport (coordinates in the tables for each range), enter and kill it. Then go back to Grizzly Adams and say {key:task}: he confirms the boss's death (*"You've killed ...! Let's continue with your normal tasks."*) and you earn the boss achievement.
To be entitled to kill bosses you always have to do hunting tasks, even if you already have 100 points.

After killing and looting the boss, leave the room and retrace your way back: the same stairs, holes (with the {item:Rope}) and boats you came by, to the nearest city. Then return to **Port Hope** and say {key:task} to {npc:Grizzly Adams}. The way to each teleport is in the "Bosses of this range" tables in sections 2 to 5.
In the {creature:Leviathan} room you only have **10 minutes** to kill and loot the boss: after that you are kicked out. The {creature:Necropharus} room can only be visited once (see section 13).
Ask for a promotion when you have points
When you have enough points for the next rank, Grizzly Adams warns you when you ask for {key:task}: *"Ask me for a promotion first."* Say {key:promotion} to rank up (see section 6).

If you completed {wiki:The Djinn War - Efreet Faction}, talk to {npc:Malor} in Mal'ouquah: {key:task}, {key:yes}. Kill 500 {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns} or {creature:Marid}. Come back and say {key:task}: you get the reward and he sends you to look for {creature:Fahim the Wise}, hidden in Yalahar.

Go to the boss teleport, on the top floor of the front tower, on the left, of Yalahar's {wiki:Magician Quarter}, and kill {creature:Fahim the Wise}. Then say {key:task} to Malor. You can ask for the task again to kill more Blue Djinns.

If you completed the {wiki:Meriana Quest}, talk to {npc:Raymond Striker}: {key:task}, {key:yes}. Kill 3000 pirates: {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats}, {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Pirate Buccaneers} or {creature:Pirate Corsair|Pirate Corsairs} — they are the pirates of Nargor.

The pirates and the leaders' hideout are in {wiki:Nargor}, west of Liberty Bay. In **Liberty Bay**, say {key:hi} and {key:peg leg} to {npc:Captain Waverider} to go to **Meriana** (50 gp). There, ask {npc:Sebastian} for {key:Nargor} (50 gp).
Handing in and going to the leaders' hideout

Come back and say {key:task}: you get coins and he tells you about a secret hideout in Nargor where you can face, one on one, one of the four pirate leaders: {creature:Brutus Bloodbeard}, {creature:Deadeye Devious}, {creature:Lethal Lissy} or {creature:Ron the Ripper}. The teleport is in Nargor ({coord:31977,32853,1}).
Teleport in the pirate leaders' hideout
Prepare well and only flee if you really have to: it may be your only chance to get into that round.
After the boss, go back the same way to {npc:Sebastian}, in Nargor: he takes you back to Liberty Bay (100 gp) or to Meriana.

After the boss, say {key:task} and {key:yes} to repeat the task. You can enter the hideout **three times** in total. After the third, you can still do the task (by asking for {key:task}), but only for the experience and money, without a boss.

If you completed the {wiki:To Outfox a Fox Quest} and are level 1–40, talk to {npc:Budrik} in the Kazordoon mines: {key:hello}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You have to kill 5000 {wiki:Minotaurs|minotaurs} anywhere.
After you accept, you can finish the task at any level.

Come back and say {key:mission}. Budrik marks the hideout of {creature:The Horned Fox} on your map. Go there and kill him: the teleport is 1 floor below the old Horned Fox hideout ({coord:32450,31988,9}). Then go back the same way. This task gives no experience and can't be repeated.

At level 60+, talk to {npc:Lugri}: {key:hello}, {key:task}, {key:yes}. You have to kill 4000 {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests}, {creature:Blood Hand|Blood Hands} or {creature:Shadow Pupil|Shadow Pupils}. He warns you there is no reward.

Come back and say {key:task}. Lugri casts a spell on you that lets you through the gate of {creature:Necropharus}, in the Halls of Sacrifice, beneath Drefia. Go to {wiki:Drefia}, west of Darashia ({coord:33018,32443,7}), and go down into the dungeon: the teleport is southeast of the star room, near the {wiki:Medusa Shield Quest}. Go in and kill him; then go back the same way to Darashia.
This is your **only** chance: if you leave the room or die, you can't go back in. This first task isn't repeatable.
Say {key:task} to Lugri to confirm you went into the room. Then say {key:task} again and {key:yes}: now you have to kill 1000 of the same creatures. This task gives experience.

The Minotaurs task and the first Necromancers task aren't repeatable. The special tasks for Demodras and Tiquandas Revenge can be repeated once if you fail the boss. All the others can be repeated several times or indefinitely.
Reaching the highest rank (Elite Hunter) doesn't lock you out of Grizzly Adams' tasks; you just stop receiving points.
There is no limit to the number of active boss tasks, but you can only have one task for each boss at a time.
The **Herbicide** achievement doesn't come from the Demons task: you get it by completing {wiki:The Demon Oak Quest} using the Holy Icon.
